doc.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Closing remarks on the cutting-session story
summary: Rowe jokes about the B-major story, mentions Parker's cymbal, and thanks her.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I wish you a lot of luck. I hope no one calls any tunes in the key of B for you.
Unless it’s you. That’s makes for a great story though see? Now you’ve had a chance to tell it on camera. I’m sure you were thinking that at the time.
That it would go down in the archives of my life. Some day I’ll need that story.

Well at least no one threw a cymbal across the floor at you. I think that’s what the famous scene from the Charlie Parker, that someone threw a cymbal because he wasn’t cutting it. Well listen, best of luck to you in your travels.
It’s been fun talking to you.
